title: DeveloperEvent
description: Shared privacy-preserving event format produced by VS Code and browser extensions. Do not include raw source code, passwords, tokens, or unnecessary sensitive browser data.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event (UUID recommended).

session_id.description: Identifier for the developer session that produced this event.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event occurred (UTC preferred).

application.description: Source application that captured the event.

event_type.description: Specific event kind within the application (e.g. file_open, tab_switch). Exact values defined per collector.

context_category.description: High-level context bucket used for task inference and privacy policy.

metadata.description: Sanitised, non-sensitive structured attributes. Must not contain raw source code, secrets, passwords, tokens, cookies, form field values, or full page content.

file_extension.description: File extension only — not full path content.

host_category.description: Coarse browser host category (e.g. docs, vcs, stackoverflow) — not full URL query strings with secrets.
